item.title: Sustainable Materials and Innovation for a Greener Future
item.description:
Embracing Nature and Innovation for a Sustainable Tomorrow
#

AceGreen Eco-Material Technology Co., Ltd. is dedicated to advancing eco-friendly materials and sustainable solutions. With a strong foundation in research and development, our journey began in 1994 when our parent company, Acelon, invested in Lyocell R&D. In 2011, AceGreen was established in Ershui Township, Changhua County, focusing on the production of cellulose filament products. Today, we are recognized among the global leaders in cellulose production, continuously striving to build greener supply chains and promote innovative green products worldwide.
